jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Firmus Technologies** Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. **Firmus AI Cloud** Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. ### **Why Firmus?** As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come. We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute. What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them. Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience. **ROLE SUMMARY** The Field Service Technician is a hands-on team player who will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient deployment, operation, maintenance, and repair of our HyperCube systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for keeping our site operations running smoothly through providing high quality technical support, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining a strong customer relationship while adhering to safety and quality standards. This role requires on-site support and a willingness to tackle various tasks, including maintenance, repair, and manual labour. **KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Equipment Maintenance & Repair: Inspect, maintain, install, and repair mechanical, electrical, computing, and ancillary systems to ensure reliable operation. * Troubleshooting & Fault Resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, applying practical solutions and escalating when necessary. * Deployment & Commissioning Support: * Assist with computer installations, modifications, and setup under the direction of the site manager. * Support HyperCube fluid handling (fill/drain) and load bank installation/removal during commissioning. * Assist with network cabling and integration into compute systems. * Support site teams during commissioning, testing, and equipment setup. * Operations & Site Management: Perform basic fault-finding, reset circuits/pumps, remove and repair faulty equipment, maintain site cleanliness, and comply with OHS requirements. * Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely updates and technical support to project and operations teams, ensuring smooth collaboration. * Documentation & Reporting: Keep accurate service records, equipment logs, and submit required documentation promptly. * Safety & Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols, maintain PPE, first aid kits, and eyewash stations. * Training & Development: Stay current on equipment, processes, and industry standards through ongoing learning. * Inventory & Quality Control: Maintain tools, spare parts, and equipment inventory; conduct quality checks post-maintenance or repair. **SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** * Diploma or equivalent, technical certification, trade qualification. * At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role, including hands-on experience with equipment maintenance and repair. * Good problem-solving and communication skills. Proven to be able to work effectively under direction. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as this position is part of a 24/7 operating roster. * Must hold an unrestricted driver’s license. * Electrical license (for electrical staff only). * Familiarity with data centre apparatus is a plus. **LOCATION & TRAVELING REQUIREMENTS** * Based in: Batam, Indonesia **EMPLOYMENT BASIS** Full-time **DIVERSITY** At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure. About Firmus Technologies Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the solution to AI’s energy challenge, founded in Australia in 2019 by a visionary team of entrepreneurs and engineers passionate about sustainable computing infrastructure. Firmus builds and operates AI infrastructure across Asia-Pacific, utilising its proprietary AI Factory platform to deliver transformative cost-effective GPU clusters and AI cloud services for developers, enterprise, education and government users. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. How to apply for this position If you think you're the right fit for us, we'd love to hear from you! Location Batam Employment basis Full time

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front-End)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **What you will be doing:** * **Ship End-to-End:** Own features from design to release—spot UX gaps early, ship core value first, log tech debt deliberately, and clean it up later. * **Partner with Product:** Analyze technical feasibility, document requirements, estimate timelines, and build work plans alongside product managers. * **Empower the Team:** Unblock peers through prompt PR reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching. * **Work Smarter with AI:** Leverage AI tools for routine tasks (unit tests, docs, clarifications) to maximize time spent on core logic. * **Lead & Architect:** Formulate web frontend architecture, drive tech stack decisions, and uphold engineering best practices. ### **What we need from you:** * **Experience:** **Minimum 3 years** of software engineering experience building Web Frontend applications (**ReactJS**). * **Technical Core:** Strong grasp of web frontend architecture, OOP, and software design patterns. * **Product Mindset:** A strong sense of ownership—treating what you ship as your own codebase is a must. * **Pragmatic Learner:** Drive to learn new technologies and apply them practically to solve business problems. * **Collaborative Spirit:** Outstanding problem-solving skills, open-mindedness to learn from peers, and a desire to elevate your team. **Nice-to-Haves:** * Full-stack versatility and readiness to tackle new frameworks across the stack. * Experience deploying software on scalable cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Global Payment - Jakarta
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location :** Jakarta **Team :** Frontend **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A137843 Responsibilities About Global Payment Team Our Web and Client team in Global Payment is committed to building a highly integrated payment product that can be easily connected to the Web, App, cross-platform and other forms of Global Payment capabilities. In addition, we provide efficient and comprehensive services to developers, merchants and others through a series of platforms. Responsibilities - Build global consumer digital wallets and payment products to support global ecosystem business and users. As part of the international payment team, participate in system design, research and development, technological innovation, etc; - Build payment products for consumer users and cross platform products based on Web technology, including mobile and PC products; - Collaborate with product design, product management and software engineering teams to drive business success in efficiency and safety; - Keep at the forefront of emerging web-based technologies and trends, research and evaluate the latest web development frameworks, apply new technologies to drive iterative product improvements. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) - Experience in developing frontend web applications - Strong in JavaScript/HTML/CSS frontend experience, skilled in common web platforms such as React/Vue/Angular, and have good practice and understanding of common web compilation and bundling frameworks, including Webpack/Rollup/Babel/AST; - Have solid experience in implementing web applications with high performance, high availability, and excellent user experience; - Good problem solving skills and thinking patterns in web-based system design. Preferred Qualification(s) - Minimum 5 years relevant work experience from a large-scale internet business. - Experience in e-wallet and payment product development; - Agile, quick self learner, highly self-motivated with a strong sense of product ownership and creative problem solver; - Good collaborator and team player, comfortable working in a fast pace, diversified and global team environment. Job Information About Us Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content. ​ Why Join ByteDance Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day. ​ As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ Diversity & Inclusion ​ ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description** Job Description Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka. Responsibilities: * You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base. * You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business. * You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems. * You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues. * You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code. * You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes Tech stack that we use: * Reactjs * NextJS * Typescript * Redux: Library * TailwindCSS * Material UI: Design System **Qualifications** We are looking for someone with: * Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms. * You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team. * You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability. * You are a strong communicator. Explaining complex technical concepts to designers, support, and other engineers is no problem for you. * You possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, programming languages, distributed systems, and information retrieval. * You have **completed** a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent training, fellowship, or work experience. **Additional Information** What will you get on working at GudangAda? * Competitive salary * Learning experience * Personal Growth * Impact at scale * Mentorship from a world-class team

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will take on a **hybrid role that combines people management with hands-on engineering**. You will be responsible for the growth and effectiveness of the team, and you will also write code, review pull requests, and shape technical designs alongside them. On this team, leads stay close to the work. Hands-on contribution is a core part of the role, not something you step back from as the team grows. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **People leadership** * Lead and develop the GEO backend team. This covers hiring, regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and supporting each engineer’s growth. * Own delivery with Product. Shape priorities, make sure commitments are realistic, and remove blockers so the team ships steadily. * Build the engineering culture of the team: shared standards, constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and collective ownership of quality. ### **Hands-on engineering** * Contribute regularly to design, code, and reviews as an active member of the team, not only as a reviewer or approver. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- ### **Must have** * Proven experience leading an engineering team with genuine people responsibility (hiring, 1:1s, performance, and delivery) while continuing to contribute code and technical design. * Motivation to stay hands-on as a lead, balancing management responsibilities with regular engineering work. * Strong proficiency in Kotlin or Groovy; proven coding skills in other JVM languages (such as Java or Scala) are a plus. * Solid experience with our core stack and architecture: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JUnit, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS and OpenAPI, applied within microservice and event-driven systems. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with Python and LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to build the technology that helps freight forwarders protect margin, improve operational efficiency, and differentiate their offering. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You won't just take tickets here. You'll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build. ### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:** * Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack. * Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale. * Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast. * Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture. * Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on. * Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. You're a builder first, with the judgment to know what's worth building. * Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible. * Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10× of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible. ### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field. * Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems. * Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early. * System Architecture: You understand how parts of a system fit together and have a strong background in building scalable products or systems. You are comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces/data sources and possess meticulous attention to detail. You are quick to generate ideas and give suggestions on how to improve the tech stack and feature developments. * First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job. * You use AI tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) where they make you faster, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read what they produce, you don't just paste it. You can defend a code path the AI suggested, or override it with reasoning the AI couldn't have known. You flag AI-assisted decisions in code review and submissions without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking. * Team Player: You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic and cross-cultural team. This role is an opportunity to drive engineering excellence within the team and participate in key architectural discussions. You are a hands-on goal-orientated engineer who works according to milestones and software guidelines, following agile principles. * Empathetic Communicator: You can communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a technical decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed. * You've either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR you've owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone else's blueprint. Either path counts! We'd love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs you'd make differently today. * Tech Stack: Ideally you are proficient with Python-based backend programming, web frameworks like Flask, Amazon Web Services. You are able to design RESTful APIs and are aware of best practices. Experience with Docker, Git, Elasticsearch, Spark, CI/CD is a plus. The specific stack matters less than how you reason about it. Strong engineers in any stack pick ours up quickly. ### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:** * Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. * Tech-first team: You’ll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems using technology. * Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you’ll be a major part of our story. * Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You’ll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. ### **Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:** * Curiosity: We read the code before we trust it. We dig into why a system behaves the way it does, not just how to make the error go away. * Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for a ticket to fix what's broken, and we stay on a problem until it's actually solved in production. * Raising the bar: We do not settle for code that only works locally or solves the immediate request. We aim for backend systems that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and easy for the team to reason about. * Effectiveness: We focus on engineering work that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship solutions that improve outcomes, not just output. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: KITCHEN PRODUCTION ANALYST OFFICER

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Jadi bagian dari tim hebat dari perusahaan global.** ------------------------------------------------------ Bergabunglah dengan perusahaan global kami dan buka peluang tanpa batas dengan berkolaborasi bersama tim yang beragam dan berbakat. Bersama-sama, kami menciptakan kesuksesan, mendorong inovasi, dan menciptakan dunia dengan berbagai peluang yang tak terbatas. ### **Detail Pekerjaan** * Conduct research about website and app UI and UX based on target audience, needs, and behaviors. * Create wireframes (basic sketches) to outline the structure and layout of the website or app. * Develop interactive UI/UX prototypes to demonstrate how the product will function. * Design the look and feel of the product, including color schemes, typography, and iconography. * Ensure the design aligns with the brand identity and is visually appealing. * Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to bring designs to life. * Create and maintain design systems or style guides to ensure consistency across the product. * Document design standards and best practices. ### **Persyaratan Keahlian** * Have minimum 3 years' experience as UI/UX Designer. * Must have experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma etc. * Must have experience in mobile and web design. * Understand design practical and user centered digital experience using modern design tools methodologies. * Can collaborate with team to improve UI/UX based expected output result. * Strong understanding of design principles, including layout, color theory, and typography. * Strong eye for detail in creating pixel-perfect designs. ### **Tingkat Pendidikan** * Bachelor Degree of Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Diploma 3 Diploma from any discipline.

We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. We strive to advise clients on how to deliver purpose-led growth and embed more equitable, inclusive as well as sustainable business practices. Hence, we seek talented individuals driven to excel and innovate, working together to achieve our shared goals. We are committed to creating positive work experiences that foster a culture of respect and inclusion, where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone is recognised for their contributions. Ready to unleash your potential with us? Join the winning team now! **Work you'll do** This role is with Deloitte Digital Southeast Asia. Across all clients and sectors, we believe great customer experiences create greater impact. That elevating the human experience creates enduring value, for the organization, for the customer, for society, for all. As part of Customer Strategy & Design (CS&D), you will work with team to help our clients with their Brand Experiences, Products and Services, Innovation Strategies, Digital Venturing and Customer Experiences, bridging Business and Customer strategies by design. We help clients connect People, Product, Purpose and Profit through the use of strategy, design and technology. Key Responsibilities: * Design intuitive, visually engaging, and scalable user interfaces for large-scale digital platforms, including super apps, mobile applications, and complex web ecosystems. * Translate business requirements, user insights, and UX wireframes into high-quality UI designs, interactive prototypes, and production-ready design specifications. * Apply design system principles, reusable components, and visual standards to ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability across multiple features and digital touchpoints. * Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to deliver seamless digital experiences aligned with business objectives and user needs. * Contribute to design reviews, usability testing, and iterative improvements to enhance usability, visual quality, and overall customer experience. * Support end-to-end design delivery, including developer handover, design QA, and refinement of implemented interfaces to ensure design fidelity. **Your role as a leader:** At Deloitte, we believe in the importance of empowering our people to be leaders at all levels. We connect our purpose and shared values to identify issues as well as to make an impact that matters to our clients, people and the communities. Additionally, Consultants across our Firm are expected to: * Actively seek out developmental opportunities for growth, act as strong brand ambassadors for the firm as well as share their knowledge and experience with others. * Respect the needs of their colleagues and build up cooperative relationships. * Understand the goals of our internal and external stakeholder to set personal priorities as well as align their teams’ work to achieve the objectives. * Constantly challenge themselves, collaborate with others to deliver on tasks and take accountability for the results. * Build productive relationships and communicate effectively in order to positively influence teams and other stakeholders. * Offer insights based on a solid understanding of what makes Deloitte successful. * Project integrity and confidence while motivating others through team collaboration as well as recognising individual strengths, differences, and contributions. * Understand disruptive trends and promote potential opportunities for improvement. **Requirements:** * Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline. * Approximately 2–5 years of experience in UI design for digital products, preferably within digital consulting, product design, or technology-driven environments. * Proven experience designing large-scale digital properties, such as super apps, multi-service platforms, digital banking applications, or complex consumer-facing ecosystems. * Strong portfolio demonstrating visual design excellence, responsive interfaces, interaction design, and the ability to manage complex user journeys and multiple product features. * Proficiency in Figma and experience working with design systems, component libraries, prototyping, and developer handover. * Good understanding of usability, accessibility, responsive design principles, and platform-specific UI guidelines. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business, design, and technology teams. **Due to volume of applications, we regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.** **Please note that Deloitte will never reach out to you directly via messaging platforms to offer you employment opportunities or request for money or your personal information. jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview:** The Civil Engineer applies their conceptual knowledge of civil and, with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward civil problems. They will be responsible for analyzing possible solutions using standard procedures and building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Civil Engineer understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Perform FEED, Studies, and detailed design engineering, analysis, and calculations on more complex and demanding engineering tasks * Apply knowledge and skills to complete varied assignments * Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses, including design reports and procedures * Prioritize and organize own work to meet deadlines * Focus on completing work within budgets * Communicate and explain information in straightforward engineering activities * Gain familiarity with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements, including identifying concerns as early as practicable * Initiate interface with other disciplines to obtain input for discipline designs * Perform computer analyses of foundations and structures designed by others with guidance from Senior/Principal Engineers * Prepare design calculations as required * Assist in the preparation of specifications with guidance from colleagues * Perform engineering check of drafting * Perform engineering checks prepared by others within the discipline * Perform design verification through single discipline check and assist with inter-discipline checks (IDC) * Prepare & review MTOs of foundations and structures under the supervision * Provide engineering support as required * Assist in the preparation of subcontract documents * Review vendor data Assist in bid evaluations Reports to: Project: Lead Engineer Functional: Supervising Department Manager Liaise With: All design/drafting disciplines, all Engineering disciplines, Construction site/Fabrication groups, and Document Control Supervises: Trainee Engineers **Essential Qualifications and Education:** * Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering * 3-8 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant, predominantly performing detail design * Preferably Registered Engineer in Training (EIT) or member of a professional engineering society as applicable * Eager to learn * Working knowledge of English, both oral and written * HSE, TQM, and cost-conscious * Show flexibility and ensure proper hand-over with regard to: + The reassignment to other departments, construction sites, and fabrication yards + The replacement of colleagues during illness and holidays. + The provision of assistance to other colleagues with heavy workloads (also other projects) when possible/desirable + The managing/learning of future current working methods and software applications * Accredited engineering degree as may be required by specific regions * Familiar with the use of codes and standards * Familiar with the content and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable. Knowledge of many basic design techniques and analysis methods * Minimum 5-10 years working experience in the heavy construction industry. * Able to use MS office, 2D AutoCAD, able do to Civil/Mechanical/Electrical analysis would be an advantage. Fluent in English both oral and written. #LI-LD1

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. What You'll Do: * *Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications.* * *Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.* * *Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.* * *Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.* * *Troubleshoot and debug applications.* * *Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.* * *Report directly to the Engineering Manager and will work closely with other engineers and a Product Manager in their dedicated stream.* What You'll Need: * *Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.* * *Experience working on both the front-end (user-facing side) and back-end (server-side)* * *Knowledge and experience in Go, React.JS, & Next.js* * *Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency systems is a plus.* * *Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.* * *Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.* * *Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.*

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About WegoPro** ----------------- WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance. * Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail. * Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy. * Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team. * Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work. * Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS. * Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications. * Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model. * Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals. * Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces. * Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't. * Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features. * Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging. * Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS. * Experience with micro-frontend architectures. * Experience building or maintaining design systems. * Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem. **Why Join WegoPro?** --------------------- At WegoPro, you'll solve meaningful engineering challenges spanning global travel inventory, multi-currency pricing, enterprise policy engines, and large-scale integrations. You'll join a highly collaborative team where engineers have real ownership, technical decisions have lasting impact, and modern AI tooling is embedded into the way we build software every day. If you're excited by complex frontend engineering, AI-native product development, and building software that powers business travel at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000427* We seek a talented and experienced Senior Product Manager with strong expertise in customer-facing mobile Apps and Desktop web platforms to join our dynamic team. Our Product Management team plays a vital role in transforming ideas into innovative products that address user experience needs and elevate the Traveloka experience. You will also be driving the development and implementation of critical technical products that enhance our platform's capabilities and help users discover and fulfill their travel inspiration and needs. * Contribute to the technical product vision and strategy across customer-facing Apps and Desktop product lines within Demand Products. * Develops and maintains detailed product roadmaps, incorporating technical input and aligning with business priorities, focusing on specific phases like ideation or post-launch optimization. * Guides and mentors junior team members, fostering technical literacy and collaboration with engineering teams. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of customer-facing platforms across Apps and Desktop. * Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis on customer-facing app and web experiences, industry UX trends, and digital product benchmarks to identify opportunities for innovation. * Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to validate product hypotheses and drive iterative improvements across Apps and Desktop. * Work with UX/UI designers and data scientists to support cohesive product strategies across platforms. * Help prioritize features and manage backlog with oversight from senior managers. * Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for product performance and identify areas for technical improvement. * Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to the product line. You will also be driving the development and implementation of critical technical products that enhance our platform's capabilities and help users discover and fulfill their travel inspiration and needs. * Contribute to the technical product vision and strategy across customer-facing Apps and Desktop product lines within Demand Products. * Develops and maintains detailed product roadmaps, incorporating technical input and aligning with business priorities, focusing on specific phases like ideation or post-launch optimization. * Guides and mentors junior team members, fostering technical literacy and collaboration with engineering teams. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of customer-facing platforms across Apps and Desktop. * Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis on customer-facing app and web experiences, industry UX trends, and digital product benchmarks to identify opportunities for innovation. * Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to validate product hypotheses and drive iterative improvements across Apps and Desktop. * Work with UX/UI designers and data scientists to support cohesive product strategies across platforms. * Help prioritize features and manage backlog with oversight from senior managers. * Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for product performance and identify areas for technical improvement. * Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to the product line. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from a reputable university. * Minimum 8 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years managing customer-facing mobile Apps and/or Desktop web products. * Experience in travel, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer app environments. * Proven experience handling customer-facing Apps and Desktop platforms, with strong understanding of cross-platform user experience, app performance, and API-driven product development. * Experience designing and running A/B tests or other experimentation methods to inform product decisions. * Strong understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum). * Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think strategically. * Proven track record of successful product launches and iterations. * Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making. * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Product Designer** ==================== Product On-site Jakarta, Indonesia **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- ‍ enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.* **Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way. ‍ **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer * Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma * Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent * Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended * Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams. #### **In your first 6 months, you might** * Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system * Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones * Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers * Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance * A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens * At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail * Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built * Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers * Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer. * Balances outcomes for both users and the business #### **Preferred (Nice to have)** * Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools * Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow * A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software * Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus ‍ If you are interested please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Location: Jakarta Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 20, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1754490 **About EY** EY is a global leader operating in over 150 countries, delivering exceptional services in Consulting and helping clients transform and strengthen their capabilities. We are committed to building a better working world by creating long-term value for clients, people, and society, while fostering trust in capital markets. This commitment begins with a culture that emphasizes learning, growth opportunities, and innovation—empowering you to make a meaningful impact. At EY, your career is yours to shape, supported by a global network, inclusive culture, and advanced technology. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to bring your voice to help us continuously improve. **The Opportunity** As a **Full Stack Engineer**, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing the WHT application. You will work across both front-end and back-end development, building intuitive React interfaces, scalable Node.js services, APIs, and end-to-end business workflows. This role provides the opportunity to work closely with business and technology teams to translate functional requirements into reliable, scalable, and user-friendly digital solutions. **Your Key Responsibilities** * Design and develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using **React** * Build and maintain scalable back-end services using **Node.js** * Design, develop, and integrate **RESTful APIs** to support application functionality and system integrations * Develop and maintain **end-to-end business workflows** for the WHT application * Translate business and functional requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions * Perform debugging, testing, code reviews, and performance optimization across front-end and back-end components * Collaborate with business analysts, UI/UX designers, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle * Ensure application security, code quality, reliability, and maintainability through engineering best practices * Support application deployment, enhancements, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering**, or a related field * Proven experience as a **Full Stack Engineer, Full Stack Developer, or Software Engineer** * Strong hands-on experience with **React and JavaScript/TypeScript** for front-end development * Strong experience developing back-end applications and services using **Node.js** * Experience designing, developing, and integrating **RESTful APIs** * Good understanding of **relational and/or NoSQL databases**, data structures, and application integration * Understanding of **Git, CI/CD, testing, and modern software development practices** * Experience working with cloud-based environments and application deployment is an advantage * Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills * Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders **What We Look For** We are looking for a hands-on and solution-oriented Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about building reliable digital applications from front end to back end. You should be comfortable working across the full application lifecycle, translating business requirements into technical solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality outcomes. **What We Offer** * **Continuous Learning:** Build future-ready skills through ongoing development and training * **Success as Defined by You:** Flexibility and tools to create meaningful impact in your own way * **Transformative Leadership:** Coaching and support to help you grow into a strong leader * **Diverse & Inclusive Culture:** An environment where your voice is valued and individuality is celebrated

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Descriptions:** **Campaign Planning & Execution** * Support the planning and execution of multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across social media, paid media, website, WhatsApp, loyalty programmes, and other relevant digital channels. * Translate marketing briefs into clear execution plans, timelines, deliverables, and campaign trackers. * Review project plans covering campaign deliverables, timelines, KOL requirements, media activities, and budgets. * Ensure campaign execution is aligned with brand objectives, commercial priorities, and agreed KPIs. **Social Media & Content Management** * Coordinate day-to-day social media activities across multiple brands, including content calendars, campaign content, and publishing schedules. * Review social media copy, articles (website content), and other digital communication materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with brand guidelines. * Support copywriting and development of communication materials for digital campaigns. * Stay updated on digital and social media trends and identify relevant opportunities for the brands. **KOL & Influencer Management** * Support end-to-end KOL and influencer campaigns, including KOL research and selection, briefing, coordination, content review, publishing schedule, and performance reporting. * Coordinate with agencies and KOL partners to ensure content and deliverables are completed according to agreed timelines and brand requirements. * Maintain structured KOL trackers and campaign documentation. **Paid Media Coordination** * Coordinate, monitor, and evaluate agency-led paid media campaigns across **Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads**. * Review media plans, campaign objectives, targeting, budget allocation, and key performance indicators together with the Digital Marketing Executive and agency. * Monitor campaign performance and flag opportunities, issues, or budget variances for further optimization. * Develop a working understanding of key digital advertising metrics and use campaign data to support decision-making. **Agency & Vendor Management** * Manage day-to-day communication and project coordination with external agencies, production partners and vendors. * Provide clear briefs, consolidate feedback from internal stakeholders, and monitor project timelines. * Ensure required assets and deliverables are completed accurately and on time. **Stakeholder Coordination** * Work closely with Team Brand and internal teams including Chef, Sales, Commercial, Sourcing, and other relevant stakeholders to support marketing initiatives. * Maintain campaign calendars, project trackers, meeting follow-ups, and deliverable timelines. * Help bridge communication between internal stakeholders and external agencies to ensure efficient campaign execution. **Events & Industry Participation** * Support digital marketing and communication requirements for roadshows, and exhibitions. * Coordinate invitations, promotional materials, digital communication, onsite branding requirements, and post-event communication. * Represent the marketing team during selected events when required. **Performance Tracking & Reporting** * Monitor and consolidate digital marketing performance including social media metrics, paid media performance, website traffic, content performance, KOL results, and other campaign KPIs. * Prepare regular campaign reports with key findings, learnings, and potential areas for improvement. * Maintain organized campaign documentation, content calendars, budget trackers, and performance trackers. **WhatsApp & Owned Digital Channels** * Support the management of WhatsApp and other owned communication channels. * Coordinate informational broadcasts, campaign messages, product updates, and other relevant communications. * Ensure messages follow brand guidelines and communication objectives. **Job Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Advertising, or a related field. * Minimum 1–2 years of full-time professional experience in Digital Marketing, Social Media, Marketing Communications, or a related field. This position is not intended for fresh graduates. * Previous experience working in a digital, social media, creative, or integrated marketing agency is highly preferred. * Experience in FMCG, F&B, Food Service, B2B food ingredients, or related industries is preferred. * Hands-on experience in managing social media platforms, content calendars, and digital campaigns. * Strong copywriting, proofreading, and content review skills. * Basic understanding of Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, digital media metrics, and campaign optimization principles. * Comfortable working with data and preparing marketing performance reports. * Proficient in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides. * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both internal teams and external partners. * Strong project management and organizational skills with high attention to detail. * Able to manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. * Proactive, collaborative, eager to learn, and comfortable challenging ideas when supported by data or insights. * Good written and verbal communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia. **"Our company has never levied any fees for the recruitment process nor has it required to order tickets and accommodation through a certain travel agent or certain person"**

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Graphic Designer and Content Creator (Indonesian Citizen Only)** ================================================================== * *Posted 01-Oct-2026 (MST)* * *Ubud, Bali, IDN* * *Other* * *Full Time* **Position Summary:** The Hotel Graphic Designer and Content Creator works within the Marketing and PR team and serves as the in-house design resource for all printed collateral and digital assets representing Capella Ubud, Bali, under the Capella Hotel Group brand and its associated business units. The purpose of this role is to produce timely and high-quality design work that authentically brings to life the vision, brand, and culture of Capella Ubud, Bali. The position requires strong design, communication, and organizational skills, along with the ability to multitask and meet deadlines. A self-motivated, proactive attitude and a collaborative spirit are essential to succeed in this fast-paced, feedback-driven environment. **Essential Duties:** * Design, coordinate production, and manage the distribution of marketing materials related to Rooms, Food & Beverage outlets (Mads Lange, Api Jiwa, Mortar & Pestle, Campfire, In-Tent Dining), events (weddings and special occasions), Auriga Wellness, the Adventure Centre, Human Resources, and other departments. * Maintain consistent brand standards across all business units and departments. * Create and manage an annual rolling production calendar, ensuring all stakeholders are informed of timelines, needs, and deadlines. * Develop and execute design concepts and assets for seasonal brand campaigns, including web design, digital and social advertisements, and print ads for magazines and newspapers. * Design and produce assets for holiday and event campaigns, including brochures, flyers, social media content, website visuals, printed banners, and on-property signage. * Manage the production of printed materials such as signage, collateral, event items, and branded materials (e.g., paper goods, packaging, props, and display items) within the allocated budget. Responsibilities include vendor sourcing, cost estimation, print specification, proof review, and final product delivery. * Coordinate local media ad placements for magazines and newspapers. * Stay updated on design trends and propose fresh, creative ideas aligned with the Capella brand identity. * Support the Marketing team in creating and distributing promotional materials throughout the hotel, including concierge areas and F&B outlets. * Review guest-facing and internal materials to ensure consistency, visual cohesion, and adherence to brand guidelines. * Provide design and printing support to all departments as required. * Assist in photoshoots, including photo list preparation, prop coordination, and styling. * Support social media content creation through photo, video, and graphic production. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Education:** * Minimum of two years of professional design experience (experience with luxury clients or brands preferred). * Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator). * Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel). * Strong proofing and copywriting skills. * Excellent project management abilities. * Experience in branding, marketing, advertising, and/or public relations is an advantage. * Prior experience in hospitality-particularly hotel or food & beverage-is an asset. * Flexibility to assist with events or photoshoots during evenings and weekends is a plus. ### **Languages** * Must be fluent in English (spoken and written). ### **Working Conditions** * This position is based in an office environment. * Must be able to sit for up to 8 hours per day. ### **Talent profile:** * High school diploma or equivalent required. * Strong command of English with the ability to communicate clearly and pleasantly with guests and colleagues, both in person and over the phone. * Ability to produce clear and legible written communication.
